keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across contract descriptions (e.g. "cybersecurity", "janitorial", "cloud migration"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: Limit to these NAICS industry codes (e.g. "541512" for Computer Systems Design Services). Leave empty for all industries.

agency.title: Awarding agency
agency.description: Exact top-tier awarding agency name (e.g. "Department of Defense", "General Services Administration"). Leave blank for all agencies.

recipientState.title: Recipient state
recipientState.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to contractors headquartered there (e.g. "TX"). Leave blank for all states.

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only return awards at or above this dollar amount.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search for new awards.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of awards to return, largest award amount first.
